purpose: Measure, on the real MFE_10D noise with the historical sequence-outcome association destroyed first, what effect size this instrument can detect after paying for all k=840 claims. It cannot change k, support, grammar or null.
quantile_selection_rule: sort canonical classes by treated_overlap ascending, tie-break by sealed j; nearest-rank index = ceil(q*n)-1. The RESULTING claim ids are recorded below so the needles survive any future change in library quantile behaviour.
base_noise: the real mfe_10d vector, permuted within the registered blocks — real scale, tails, date shocks and heteroskedasticity kept; sequence-outcome association destroyed
injection: delta added ONLY to the frozen needle's membership, inside its overlap blocks
detection: theta_needle > p95 of that world's max-null across all 840 claims

rng.separation: outer and inner streams are independent so that the randomness making a world is not tied to the randomness building that world's band

reporting: measured finite-suite detection rate — never 'true power'
may_not: become a promotion route for any claim
y_status: capability may read mfe_10d; historical ranking stays unexposed
